-- Update Oregon Senate race: Jeff Merkley (D) vs Jo Rae Perkins (R, leading R candidate)
UPDATE senate_races SET
  incumbent = 'Jeff Merkley',
  incumbent_party = 'D',
  candidate1_name = 'Jeff Merkley',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Jo Rae Perkins',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  status = 'Primary',
  rating = 'Solid D',
  notes = 'Incumbent Jeff Merkley (D) seeking his 3rd term. Primary May 19, 2026. Republican primary features 7 candidates including Jo Rae Perkins (2020 and 2022 GOP nominee) and David Brock Smith (state rep). Merkley won 2020 with 56.9%. Rated Solid D by all outlets.'
WHERE state_code = 'OR' AND is_special = 0;

-- Update Kentucky Senate race: Andy Barr (R, Trump-endorsed) vs Charles Booker (D, frontrunner)

  incumbent = 'Open Seat (Mitch McConnell retired)',
  incumbent_party = 'R',
  candidate1_name = 'Andy Barr',
  candidate1_party = 'R',
  candidate2_name = 'Charles Booker',
  candidate2_party = 'D',
  status = 'Primary',
  rating = 'Solid R',
  notes = 'Open seat — Mitch McConnell (R) retiring after 40 years. Republican primary: Andy Barr (Trump-endorsed, incumbent KY-6 rep) vs Daniel Cameron (former AG) and 9 others. Democratic primary: Charles Booker (progressive, prior Senate candidate) vs Amy McGrath (ran vs McConnell 2020), Dale Romans, Pamela Stevenson, and others. Kentucky is R+26; rated Solid R by all outlets.'
WHERE state_code = 'KY' AND is_special = 0;
